text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the discipline-specific athletic meet. 
A clash between Mr. C.B., Symboli Rudolf, 
and Katsuragi Ace became a reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The young man running "Weekly Pacat 
Channel" also comes to watch the race. He 
interviews Mr. C.B. and Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf mentions she is refining 
her strategy for the race. Mr. C.B., on 
the other hand, said she would make no 
plans and simply run freely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace claimed 1st place in the 
race. Mr. C.B. suffered a crushing defeat 
in 10th place. Though frustrated, she 
showed no signs of being disheartened.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying she was getting fired up, a smile 
even surfaced on her face. Seeing that, 
the young man trembled with frustration, 
wondering if she even cared about winning.
